decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the core agency-focused, round-the-clock support offer, costs little to keep available, and preserves an upsell option on the existing service team.

The version management tool is integrated into the platform's management toolset alongside the security center and recovery manager, so carrying it costs little and it supports the strategy of reducing recurring operational work.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer and its GDPR-driven demand spike has likely faded, but as a low-maintenance online tool it remains a cheap option with some compliance value for agency customers, so abandonment is not yet clearly justified.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship and strategic focus, closely aligned with the firm's core and its owned data center capacity, so it warrants further commitment rather than abandonment.
